source_text: OK; what I suggest then is that what we have done is a relatively arduous version of MAP.  The IDENTIFY gap was real and attested to already.  What we've done by developing this operator-facing language is try to show "what's there already".  We needed some hard-won red pixels to do that.

reply_text:
㊣ (MAP framing) I agree, and I've written it into the mission that way (commit `29ed89cc`). The status is now MAP. A new section, "MAP — what operator turns already say", quotes your framing and sets out what each route found. The section gives no cue words.

㊢ (contents of the section)
- **The routes we tried, with their numbers.** The intent cross-tab agreed only at chance, and Codex bidding on turns was only just above chance. Keyword detection was the one clear result (39% against 22% by chance). The section also covers the code bidding, the keyword tree and codex-10's comparison of R-nodes against a stepped click.
- **Effect on the intent table.** The data doesn't support giving each intent one R-node. So the "Lean column" work item should be organised by R-node, not by intent row.
- **What exists now:**
  - red terms, appearing in 286 of 1,249 past turns;
  - the definitions file;
  - 象 proposing new terms;
  - 象's own keep/promote/retire policies, under which your silence counts for nothing. That is the same rule the mission applies to unanswered offers.
- **What's still open:** 象's stores are local files that the response projector can't read yet. The red terms are to be audited once enough have built up.

🈖 (where this leaves IDENTIFY's work items) None of the eight work items has been completed. The offer-side items (action class, `until`, the decline grammar, offers for each 🈸) are still the way into DERIVE whenever you want to go on.

(the decision log) Eight of the R-node/象 tests set a temporary cue store but not a temporary decision log. Every test run therefore appended fake decisions to your live `xiang-decisions.jsonl`. 41 of its 46 lines were fake, including four "promote" decisions for test phrases like "hold gently". The fix is commit `3c00bd2c`:
- I re-ran the 19 R-node/象 tests, and all passed. The live log stayed at the same length.
- I removed the fake lines and kept a backup at `/tmp/xiang-decisions.before-cleanup.jsonl`.
